pr.title: Fix search saying No items yet. when nothing matches

findings.what: The PR says the tests failed before the fix. I couldn't confirm that, because vitest isn't installed here and `npm test` failed with 'vitest: not found'. By reading the diff, the first two new tests would fail on the old code. The third (empty table) would pass on it.
findings.fix: Run the suite in CI or locally and confirm the result.

lenses.note: The change does what the title says: a search with no matches and a non-empty table now shows a no-match message. An empty table still shows 'No items yet.'. It is a small bug fix with no new options.
There is no spec file in this change, so there are no acceptance items.

The new tests in test/search.test.js cover the no-match message, HTML escaping of the search text, and the empty-table case. Each asserts rendered output. I could not run them (vitest is not installed here). No tests were deleted or loosened.
The README and CLAUDE.md say nothing about the empty-state message.
The extra COUNT query runs only when a search finds nothing. The search text is escaped in the message. I found no defects.

The search text is escaped before it goes into the HTML. The SQL is parameterised. The `empty` string is the only value interpolated into the page unescaped, and it is built from constants plus escaped text.
The diff touches no UI files beyond one server-rendered message string.
The diff touches no UI files beyond one server-rendered message string.
The title is under 72 characters and the body matches the diff. The only claim I couldn't check is that the new tests failed before the fix.
